notes.title: UPDATE 2 | Changelist
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33698531/e998a35de845fa22edb4a9bcb5671da589805cce.png[/img]

[h1][b]Added new level[/b][/h1]

This time, players will have to fight monsters in the provincial quarter of an ordinary Russian town. In size, the map is more than 10 times the area of ​​the first and includes a diverse landscape with vertical gameplay and rich destructible surroundings.

[h1][b]Added collectibles[/b][/h1]

You will find a unique gameplay, in the form of collecting bottles of beer.

[h1][b]Changed weapon balance[/b][/h1]

Partially redesigned weapon characteristics

[h1][b]Minor changes to the network part[/b][/h1]

The network part has undergone many important corrections, such as the inability to cause damage to monsters, if the player joined the session during the running wave

[h1][b]Added text chat[/b][/h1]

For the convenience of communication between unfamiliar players, we have introduced the possibility of text messaging.

[h1][b]Monster behavior changes[/b][/h1]

Arachnids and Boss are now immune to shots from Pisengun

[h1][b]Achievements[/b][/h1]

32 achievements added to the game

notes.title: UPDATE 0 | Changelist
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33698531/631bfe357765dac5b91ef3deffb60cfb545d9d83.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Major changes to the network part[/b][/h1]

The lobby system has been replaced by a "hot" connection to the already created server. Now you can even connect to the game, in which several waves have already passed. Privacy settings are left unchanged, if you do not want other players to connect to your game, then simply select the desired server type.
Also minor issues were fixed and network code was optimized.

[h1][b]Long start game[/b][/h1]

Game launch has been significantly accelerated.

[h1][b]Fixed the problem of players leaving the game area[/b][/h1]

Some curious players could find a loophole in the colliders that limit the active playing area.

[h1][b]Changed the spawn points of monsters[/b][/h1]

Spawn monsters indoors forced players to retreat to the street on the last waves and shoot opponents from afar. Now outside the club no less dangerous than inside.

[h1][b]Fixed physical model of monster attacks[/b][/h1]

Now the monsters can not push the player outside the game area.

[h1][b]Transfer of money[/b][/h1]

Added the ability to share money with other players. Use the L button to throw away some money.

[h1][b]Minigun[/b][/h1]

Fixed a problem with a drop in frame rate when using a minigun.

[h1][b]Dildo cannon[/b][/h1]

Performance improved.

[h1][b]Sounds[/b][/h1]

Fixed problem with playing incorrect sounds
